provenance: Independently authored from maintainer-approved M4 decisions before mapper implementation; not generated by production code.

capture.boundary: Owned Node HTTP/1.1 listener before framework conversion or rewrite
capture.headerCompleteness: Established through compatible parser byte/count limits before accepting connections; never inferred from a truncated array
capture.obsTextValues: Owned bytes from Node Latin-1 values, never guessed UTF-8
capture.http2: Explicit http2-unsupported mapping failure; no synthesized HTTP/1.1 request

targetOrigin.comparison: Lowercase host and effective port against an explicit allowed-origin set
targetOrigin.ipLiterals: Explicitly allowed IPv4 and IPv6 targets are supported
targetOrigin.nonDefaultPorts: Explicitly allowed ports from 1 through 65535 are supported
targetOrigin.signatureInput: Preserve observed authority, path and query spelling; canonical comparison must not rewrite them
targetOrigin.host: Exactly one valid HTTP/1.1 Host occurrence, including behind ingress; no pseudo-header fallback

direct.forwardingHeaders: Preserved as raw headers but ignored for target and client trust

trustedIngress.peer: Immediate socket peer checked against explicit locally configured IP/CIDR rules
trustedIngress.operatorAssertion: Ingress strips client-supplied selected forwarding fields and writes a single unambiguous value
trustedIngress.loopbackWarning: Trusting loopback also trusts other local processes able to connect; it is not process authentication
trustedIngress.familyConflict: Forwarded together with any X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Forwarded-Port or X-Forwarded-For is rejected

forwarded.grammar: RFC 7239 token / quoted-string, with node grammar for for/by including unknown and obfuscated identifiers
forwarded.nodeTrust: Neither for nor by establishes authentication or peer trust

xForwarded.occurrences: Exactly one for each required field; at most one for each optional field
xForwarded.for: One canonical IPv4 or IPv6 address, without a port
xForwarded.port: Integer from 1 through 65535; must equal an explicit host port, or the protocol default when host has no port
xForwarded.absentPort: No port is added to a portless authority
xForwarded.otherProxyFields: Other X-Forwarded-* fields and X-Real-IP are not members of the selected family; preserve but ignore for trust, without rejecting their presence

observedClient.value: Validated Forwarded for value or single X-Forwarded-For IP; never substitute by
observedClient.port: Separate optional field, including RFC 7239 obfuscated node-port where supplied
observedClient.absent: Omit the entire hint when for is absent

mappingFailure.observe: Publish mapping-rejected plus code, notify observer, and continue without verification or authorization permission
mappingFailure.enforce: Pass mapping-rejected to the policy hook; only deny or rate-limit can take effect; every continuation decision becomes deny

policy.duplicateCompatibleInstallation: Reuse request-owned work; never verify or consume a nonce twice
policy.context: Readonly public view with private authoritative ownership checks

body.enforcementDefault: Reject framed bodies unless identity-only acceptance is explicitly selected
body.framing: Transfer-Encoding or nonzero Content-Length, independent of method

parserRejection.category: Before application capture, separate from mapping failure
